description: The Geoportal of Hrvatske vode, the Croatian water management agency, is an interactive web viewer of spatial data in thematic groups. Its topics are the preliminary flood risk assessment; flood hazard maps showing high, medium (100-year return period) and low probability scenarios, with water depths computed from the national digital terrain model; flood risk maps at 1:25,000 showing the potential adverse consequences of the three scenarios, built from census, land cover and protected area registers; the register of agglomerations with their loads and the sensitive areas and catchments under the urban wastewater directive; and the register of protected areas for water. The viewer supports attribute and spatial search, overlays from WMS and KML, printing and KML export of drawn objects, and the agency also runs a water level application. Coverage is Croatia. Access is free online through the web map viewer. Caveats: the data are stated to be informative only, no licence or bulk download was given on the page, and flood maps are revised in six-year cycles. Simulation uses: flood exposure of assets and sewer agglomeration planning. Related records: Romania ANAR flood hazard maps (data-romania-anar-flood-hazard-maps) and the Polish ISOK Hydroportal (data-poland-isok-hydroportal-flood-hazard-risk-maps).
